description: Same-task control pool: multiple DistilBERT LoRA adapters fine-tuned on sentiment/emotion classification tasks. Tests whether Gradience stays appropriately conservative on a clean same-task pool.
trial_purpose: Confirm same-task safe zones feel useful and non-annoying. Gradience should not overcomplicate a clean pool.

adapters.notes: IMDB binary sentiment. Standard PEFT LoRA adapter.
IMDB binary sentiment. Different author, same task+backbone.
Text classification LoRA. Task not specified — possible same-task or slight variation.
Emotion classification (4-class). Related to sentiment but not identical.

selection_rationale: All four share the same backbone (distilbert-base-uncased). Two are clearly same-task (IMDB sentiment, different authors). One is similar (text classification, possibly same dataset). One is adjacent (emotion classification). This pool should trigger same-task safe zones for the IMDB pair and provide a mild boundary test with the emotion adapter.

expected_gradience_behavior.same_task_safe_zones: IMDB pair should be in same-task safe zone
expected_gradience_behavior.cross_task_caution: Emotion adapter may trigger mild cross-task advisory
expected_gradience_behavior.exclusions: None expected — all adapters should be clean
expected_gradience_behavior.overall: Conservative posture, low reduction ratio, most pairs retained
